verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures only whether the answer is laid out as a list versus prose, explicitly excluding whether the structure helps or the steps are correct.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Measures whether symbols are introduced and used consistently so the argument can actually be followed, which bears on the substance of the mathematical communication rather than its typesetting.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Directly assesses whether the load-bearing mathematical steps are supplied and justified exactly once, a core substantive-rigor property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts the sheer extent of quoting/attribution as a textual habit rather than judging the mathematics, though answerers who closely quote the asker's work may also be the ones engaged enough to spot the actual error.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Flags a generic AI-style phrasing fingerprint independent of correctness, though the underlying LLM authorship this detects could also plausibly produce genuinely more complete or correct content.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the step a reader would most doubt is actually argued rather than asserted, which is substantive evidentiary support for the answer.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures how much of the opening is spent on scene-setting or restatement as a pacing habit, explicitly without judging whether that orientation is helpful, necessary, or well written.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Assesses whether the answer correctly diagnoses the specific flaw in the asker's approach and explains why it fails, a substantive content judgment.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Measures whether the argument is actually carried through and specialised to the specific object asked rather than left generic, a substantive completeness property.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Pure count of set-off display-math markup blocks relative to length, explicitly not judging whether the enclosed mathematics is correct, needed, or well chosen.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures typesetting/markup density versus plain ASCII orthography, an explicitly cosmetic dimension the prompt separates from whether the mathematics is right.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts second-person coaching, reassurance, and imperative language as an interpersonal-tone marker, though a more engaged, patient explainer might also be somewhat more likely to spell out genuine justifications elsewhere in the answer.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Requires a stated, mathematically real reason for the chosen method rather than a bare signpost word, which is substantive evidence about the quality of the argument.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Requires the mechanism of a specific mathematical failure mode to be named and explained, a substantive content property independent of tone or warmth.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures raw length, elaboration, and repetition as a volume metric, though greater elaboration could sometimes reflect genuinely more complete coverage of needed steps rather than pure padding.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Scores only the rhetorical framing of scope (fragment/hint versus complete solution) as stated in the text, not whether that scope choice is appropriate or the content within it is good.
